content:
No, you should not use drain cleaner or any other toxic substances to color food. Drain cleaner contains harmful chemicals that can be toxic and dangerous if ingested. 

If you want to add a blue coloring to your waffles, consider using food-safe coloring options like food coloring or natural alternatives such as blueberries, blue spirulina, or butterfly pea powder. These options are safe and will give your waffles a nice blue hue.
